provenance.l: NASA, Demo-2 return: Crew Dragon drogues at ~18,000 ft, mains at ~6,000 ft

NASA: splashdown at 2:48 p.m. EDT, 2 Aug 2020, in the Gulf of Mexico off Pensacola, Florida; 64 days in orbit, 1,024 orbits. Estimated: the splashdown point (the release says only off Pensacola); the entry mass and Cd·A are the Inspiration4 profile's Crew Dragon figures
Entry interface at 122 km and the entry angle as the Inspiration4 profile (the angle tuned for the US Standard Atmosphere 1976 table, 2026-11-25)
